intro.title: More keys
intro.text: Sharp keys add one sharp each time: G (F♯), D (+C♯), A (+G♯), E (+D♯). Flat keys add flats: F (B♭), B♭ (+E♭), E♭ (+A♭), A♭ (+D♭).

intro.title: Relative minors
intro.text: Every major key shares its signature with a minor key three notes below: D minor goes with F major, G minor with B♭ major.

intro.title: A major
intro.text: Three sharps: F♯, C♯ and G♯. Right thumb on A4.
